__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Select the Prometheus instance scraping Borg Backup UI.

title: Borg Backup UI · Backup Overview
description: Backup activity, results, storage efficiency and recovery planning for Borg Backup UI. Uses built-in Grafana panels and the optional plugin exporter.

options.content:
BORG BACKUP UI
Backup overview
Your backups. Your storage. Your recovery evidence.

panels.title: Dashboard data
panels.description: Whether the dashboard could read all information sources. Backup and restore results are shown separately. See Dashboard data & notes below for details.

panels.title: BACKUP JOBS
panels.description: Configured jobs within the selected filters; enabled and disabled jobs are included.

panels.title: LATEST RUNS SUCCESSFUL
panels.description: Count of jobs whose latest result is successful, not successful executions in the selected time range.

panels.title: ARCHIVES IN REPOSITORIES
panels.description: Cached repository archive total. The Job filter applies to job panels only.

panels.title: STORED IN REPOSITORIES
panels.description: Cached unique compressed chunks, not filesystem usage.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Active backup and restore-test jobs in the selected filters. Updated on the next exporter snapshot and Prometheus scrape; short operations can finish between samples. No active jobs is shown only with a reachable exporter, a successful runtime read and a snapshot under 3 minutes old. No data means activity is unknown.

targets.expr: ((label_replace((max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) (bbui_backup_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"}) == 1), "operation", "Backup", "job_id", ".*") or label_replace((max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) (bbui_restore_test_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"}) == 1), "operation", "Restore test", "job_id", ".*")) and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180)) or (label_replace((sum(bbui_backup_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"} and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180)) + sum(bbui_restore_test_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"} and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180)) == 0), "job_name", "No active jobs", "job_id", ".*"))

panels.title: Restore evidence
panels.description: Evidence according to the plugin policy. Not required is separate from verified. This is not proof of complete application recovery.

panels.title: Failed / warning
panels.description: Current snapshot. Missing metrics remain No data.

panels.title: Backups overdue
panels.description: Current snapshot. Missing metrics remain No data.

panels.title: Restore tests overdue
panels.description: Current snapshot. Missing metrics remain No data.

panels.title: Active operations
panels.description: Current snapshot. Missing metrics remain No data.

targets.expr: sum(bbui_backup_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"} and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180)) + sum(bbui_restore_test_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job"} and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180))

panels.title: Job status · activity and latest backup result

panels.description: One equally sized card per job and location. Running activity takes priority; otherwise the latest recorded backup result is shown. Activity follows exporter and scrape intervals. Overdue status and recovery evidence remain separate.

targets.expr: ((max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) ((bbui_backup_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}"} * 6 + on(instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) bbui_restore_test_running{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}"} * 7) > 0)) and on(instance) (up{job="borg-backup-ui",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (bbui_collector_success{instance=~"$instance",collector="runtime"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - bbui_metrics_generated_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) < 180)) or (max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) ((bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="success"} == 1) * 0 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="warning"} == 1) * 1 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="error"} == 1) * 2 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="skipped"} == 1) * 3 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="cancelled"} == 1) * 4 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",job_id=~"${tile_job:regex}",result="unknown"} == 1) * 5))

panels.title: Repository data reduction
panels.description: Cached unique compressed chunks compared with original bytes across all archives. Includes compression and reuse across archives, not free disk space.

panels.title: Original → compressed → stored
panels.description: A common scale shows the difference between original bytes, compressed bytes and unique stored bytes across repository archives. These are cached values, not live disk usage.

panels.title: Storage by location
panels.description: Stored bytes by configured storage type. Multiple locations do not prove independent or offsite copies.

panels.title: Latest archive insights · one archive per job
Largest latest archives · top 6
panels.description: One latest recorded success/warning archive per job; creation dates may differ. Top six within the filters. These are not daily totals.

panels.title: Most new data · top 6
panels.description: One latest recorded success/warning archive per job; creation dates may differ. Top six within the filters. These are not daily totals.

panels.title: Backups · last success and next plan
panels.description: Jobs are matched by ID and server. No pagination: scroll the table if needed. Last success is limited to retained status history. The last result and the age of success mean different things.

targets.expr: max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) ((bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="success"} == 1) * 0 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="warning"} == 1) * 1 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="error"} == 1) * 2 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="skipped"} == 1) * 3 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="cancelled"} == 1) * 4 or (bbui_backup_last_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",result="unknown"} == 1) * 5)

panels.title: Recovery · evidence and next test
panels.description: Complete restore verification details. Evidence expiry and planned test are separate. A dash means no exported value. Server is selected at the top.

targets.expr: max by (instance,job_id,job_name,location,repository) ((bbui_restore_verification_state{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",state="verified"} == 1) * 0 or (bbui_restore_verification_state{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",state="stale"} == 1) * 1 or (bbui_restore_verification_state{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",state="failed"} == 1) * 2 or (bbui_restore_verification_state{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",state="never"} == 1) * 3 or (bbui_restore_verification_state{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",job_name=~"$backup_job",state="not_required"} == 1) * 4)

panels.title: Repository inventory
panels.description: Repository statistics are cached. Refresh is the last attempt's result; a failed attempt can leave older size values in place. Collection reads cached metadata without running Borg or refreshing repositories. Job filter does not narrow repository totals; use Repository or Location.

targets.expr: max by (instance,repository,repository_name,location) ((bbui_repository_refresh_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",result="success"} == 1) * 0 or (bbui_repository_refresh_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",result="warning"} == 1) * 1 or (bbui_repository_refresh_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",result="error"} == 1) * 2 or (bbui_repository_refresh_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",result="busy"} == 1) * 3 or (bbui_repository_refresh_result{instance=~"$instance",location=~"$location",repository=~"$repository",result="unknown"} == 1) * 4)

panels.title: History · stored data and run duration
Repository storage trend
panels.description: Cached stored-byte snapshots. Flat lines are expected between repository information refreshes.

panels.title: Backup duration trend
panels.description: Latest-run duration at each scrape, not an event log. Initial collection has little history.

options.content:
**About these checks**  
These checks show whether the dashboard could read each type of information. Backup and restore results are shown in the overview above. If information could not be loaded, check the plugin log and the connection.

panels.title: Dashboard data
panels.description: Information available for this dashboard on the selected server. Available means the data could be read; it does not mean that a backup or restore test succeeded. No data means no current result is available.

options.content:
**Repository totals** use cached Borg information. **Latest archives** aggregate one recorded archive per job; dates may differ.

**Server, Location and Repository** filter the relevant panels. **Job** filters job, archive and restore panels only. Health cards monitor the selected server.

**No data / —** means no usable sample, not a healthy zero. Check the Connection, Dashboard data and Snapshot age cards first. History begins when Prometheus starts collecting.

This dashboard needs only Grafana's built-in panels and the existing Borg Backup UI exporter.
